description: Defines a class LeaveTypeMenuConfigurator that implements MenuConfigurator for configuring menu items related to leave types in the OrangeHRM system. It overrides the current screen to 'leaveTypeList'.

classes.name: LeaveTypeMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for leave types and overrides the screen to 'leaveTypeList'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'leaveTypeList' within the provided Screen object.
